title: Spiced {p} & {v} Pilaf
steps: Warm a little oil, add the {spice} and stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the {p} and {v} and cook a few minutes, stirring, until lightly browned.
Stir in the {s} to coat, add the {sauce} and enough water to cover the rice by a knuckle, then cover and simmer on low until the rice is tender (about 15 minutes for white rice, 40 for brown).
Check that any chicken or lamb is at least 165°F / 74°C inside, then fluff with a fork, rest 5 minutes covered, and finish with lemon or fresh herbs.
tip: Brown rice and extra veg add fiber, and a tablespoon of oil is plenty.
